title: KAITO — Happy Anniversary! 2024〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: KAITO's Voice
rows.Line: Everyone! Thank you for coming to my anniversary show today!

rows.Speaker: KAITO's Voice
rows.Line:
Hehe. Sounds like you've all got lots of energy!
Alright, now for the countdown to start the show. Here we go!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Zero! The anniversary show starts now!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hello everyone! I'm happy to see you all!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Let's enjoy all the time we have here today!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Everyone's really hyped up right off the bat!
Alright, let's use that energy to celebrate KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Happy anniversary, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy anniversary!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Whoa... Thank you all, this makes me so happy!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: KAITO! There's lots and lots of excitement from everyone watching the stream, too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're right! The comments are flooding in!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: All of you watching out there, thank you! I can feel your support all the way from here.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Let's clap and do some chants together so you can all be a part of the show!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Don't worry, we'll set aside time to practice!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: After we go over them, let's celebrate KAITO's anniversary to the fullest!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sounds good! Then to get right into the swing of things, we'll start practicing the chant to the first song!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: For everyone watching the stream, feel free to try it at home!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, just be careful not to disturb your neighbors!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's so like you to worry about that...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Alright everyone! Remember what we just practiced♪
Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You guys are amazing!
Your voices all came together so nicely!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And all of you watching the stream, your timing with the comments is perfect!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Just like that, everyone♪
Alright, do you remember the next set of choreography?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
One, two, three, four!
Right hand, left hand, spin, spin, spin!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
One more time!
All together everybody! One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: KAITO, Rin & Len
rows.Line: Right hand, left hand, spin, spin, spin!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'd like to thank you all once again for coming to my anniversary show today.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Doing chants together, clapping along, dancing... I had such an amazing time!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Did all of you have fun?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: It was suuuper fun!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Come on now, what's the point of you two answering?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Alright then, KAITO.
Lastly, we have some messages for you!
song00010_off_s

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, KAITO!
Thank you for watching over us, giving us guidance, and just helping us out in all kinds of ways!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope we can keep singing and hanging out, and get to have lots more fun times together!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Today's show was really fun.
It was like all of our hearts became one!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
And you were super good at teaching everyone!
I wanna learn from you and get to a point where I can guide people and have them rely on me!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: KAITO, I wish you a very happy anniversary. I'm happy I was able to help everyone enjoy being a part of the show together like you wanted.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: KAITO does tend to prioritize others over himself, doesn't he?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. But it really is just like him for his wishes to be connected to others' smiles.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Absolutely. It's who he is, and that's why so many people are celebrating him.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
KAITO, remember it's okay to loosen up more every once in a while!
Have a very happy anniversary!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, everyone.
Your heartfelt messages made me really happy.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You told me that I'm guiding you all, but...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The reason I'm able to move forward with my head held high is that I have all of you supporting me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Just know that I also rely on all of you. I hope we can continue to be there for each other!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course!
